<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <!-- Collaboration and pool -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="ORG" name="Luxury Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_1"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CustomerConfirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sales" name="Sales">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveSpecs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BarSelect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_BarMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverPlane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Russian" name="Russian Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureVodkaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Irish" name="Irish Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Assembly" name="Assembly Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureTequilaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureGinBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureRumBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureSeats</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PaintInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FillWater</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ParallelEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Test" name="Test Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PerformTestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveSpecs" name="Receive specifications from customer"/>

    <!-- Bar selection gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BarSelect" name="Select bar type"/>

    <!-- Bar manufacturing tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Manufacture vodka bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Manufacture whiskey bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureTequilaBar" name="Manufacture tequila bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureGinBar" name="Manufacture gin bar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureRumBar" name="Manufacture rum bar"/>

    <!-- Merge after bar manufacturing -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BarMerge" name="Bar manufactured"/>

    <!-- Parallel split for other interior parts -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ParallelStart" name="Prepare interior parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureSeats" name="Manufacture seats"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PaintInterior" name="Paint interior color"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FillWater" name="Fill water in toilets"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_ParallelEnd" name="Interior parts ready"/>

    <!-- Assembly -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior"/>

    <!-- Test flight -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PerformTestFlight" name="Perform test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>

    <!-- Communication and delivery -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver plane to customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomerConfirm" name="Customer confirms delivery"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_1" name="Process complete"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSpecs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSpecs" targetRef="Gw_BarSelect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3_Vodka" sourceRef="Gw_BarSelect" targetRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bar = 'vodka'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4_Whiskey" sourceRef="Gw_BarSelect" targetRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bar = 'whiskey'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5_Tequila" sourceRef="Gw_BarSelect" targetRef="Task_ManufactureTequilaBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bar = 'tequila'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6_Gin" sourceRef="Gw_BarSelect" targetRef="Task_ManufactureGinBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bar = 'gin'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7_Rum" sourceRef="Gw_BarSelect" targetRef="Task_ManufactureRumBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bar = 'rum'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8_Vodka" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gw_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9_Whiskey" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" targetRef="Gw_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10_Tequila" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureTequilaBar" targetRef="Gw_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11_Gin" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureGinBar" targetRef="Gw_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12_Rum" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureRumBar" targetRef="Gw_BarMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Gw_BarMerge" targetRef="Gw_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14_Seats" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_ManufactureSeats"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15_Paint" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_PaintInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16_FillWater" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_FillWater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F17_SeatsDone" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureSeats" targetRef="Gw_ParallelEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F18_PaintDone" sourceRef="Task_PaintInterior" targetRef="Gw_ParallelEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F19_FillWaterDone" sourceRef="Task_FillWater" targetRef="Gw_ParallelEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F20" sourceRef="Gw_ParallelEnd" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F21" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_PerformTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F22" sourceRef="Task_PerformTestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F23" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F24" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F25" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_CustomerConfirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F26" sourceRef="Task_CustomerConfirm" targetRef="End_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
